headline: Germany Builds World's Tallest Series Wind Turbine
meta_description: Germany has completed the world's tallest series-produced onshore wind turbine at 285 metres, generating 17–18 million kWh annually.
summary_short: Germany has completed the world's tallest series-produced onshore wind turbine, standing 285 metres tall with remarkable energy output.
body:
Germany has completed construction of the world's tallest series-produced onshore wind turbine, a landmark achievement in renewable energy infrastructure.

The turbine stands 285 metres tall with a hub height of 199 metres. Its 7.2 MW capacity positions it among the most powerful onshore installations in operation, designed to generate between 17 and 18 million kilowatt-hours annually—enough to power thousands of homes.

This completion reflects Germany's continued commitment to expanding its renewable energy capacity. By pushing the boundaries of turbine height and efficiency, the project demonstrates how engineering advances in wind technology can unlock greater energy production from single installations, reducing the need for sprawling turbine arrays while maximizing output per structure.
